overview.support: Same architecture can power other procedural worlds, simulations and interactive storytelling.
provider.label: Provider-independent
sr: Procedural Detective architecture. A crime prompt moves through AI generation into an interactive world. A deterministic validator and solver check consistency, reachable clues, and a valid solution before the mystery becomes playable. The provider-independent architecture can use hosted AI or local Ollama.
